description: Archive a workflow: it leaves the active list and can no longer be edited or deployed until the owner restores it in the Nodes2Cloud editor. Nothing is permanently deleted, and a version already deployed keeps running in the user's Cloudflare account. Only use this when the user asks to remove a workflow. Archiving twice is harmless.

workflowId.description: The workflow's id, from list_workflows or create_workflow.

name: archive_workflow
title: Archive workflow
